tasks.title: Initialize Elixir Phoenix Umbrella Project with LiveView
tasks.description: Create a new Phoenix umbrella project named livekit_server with a web app (LiveView) and core app, configure PostgreSQL, Docker, and Fly.io deployment with release build.
tasks.details:
## Step 1: Install Compatible Versions
- Erlang/OTP 27
- Elixir 1.17.x
- Phoenix ~> 1.7.12 (works with LiveView)

```bash
elixir --version
# Elixir 1.17.x (compiled with Erlang/OTP 27)
```

## Step 2: Create Umbrella Project
```bash
mix new livekit_server --umbrella
cd livekit_server

# Create Phoenix Web App
mix phx.new apps/livekit_web --live --no-mailer --no-dashboard --database postgres --app livekit_web

# Create Core App
mix new apps/livekit_core --app livekit_core
```

## Step 3: Link Apps
- Add `livekit_core` to deps in `apps/livekit_web/mix.exs`:
```elixir
{:livekit_core, in_umbrella: true}
```

## Step 4: Fly.io Config
Create `fly.toml` in root:
```toml
app = "livekit-server"
primary_region = "lax"

[build]
  dockerfile = "Dockerfile"

[env]
  PHX_HOST = "livekit-server.fly.dev"
  PORT = "4000"

[http_service]
  internal_port = 4000
  force_https = true
  auto_stop_machines = true
  auto_start_machines = true
  min_machines_running = 0
  processes = ["app"]

[[vm]]
  size = "shared-cpu-1x"
  memory = "512mb"
```

## Step 5: Dockerfile (with release build)
```dockerfile
FROM elixir:1.17-alpine AS build
RUN apk add --no-cache build-base git npm python3
WORKDIR /app

# Install Hex + Rebar
RUN mix local.hex --force && mix local.rebar --force

# Copy mix files
COPY mix.exs mix.lock ./
COPY config config

# Install deps
RUN mix deps.get --only prod && mix deps.compile

# Copy umbrella apps
COPY apps apps

# Build assets and release
RUN MIX_ENV=prod mix assets.deploy
RUN MIX_ENV=prod mix release

# Final image
FROM alpine:3.18
RUN apk add --no-cache libstdc++ openssl ncurses-libs
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=build /app/_build/prod/rel/livekit_server ./
CMD ["bin/livekit_server", "start"]
```

## Step 6: Local Verification
```bash
mix deps.get
mix ecto.create
mix phx.server
```

If DB not running:
```bash
pg_ctl -D /usr/local/var/postgres start
```

tasks.title: Implement Inbound Call Handler
tasks.description: Build LiveKit agent for handling inbound calls with AI agent selection and CRM lookup
tasks.details:
services/ai-agent/src/inbound_handler.py:
```python
class InboundHandler:
    async def handle_call(self, room):
        lead = await self.lookup_lead(room.phone_number)
        agent = await self.select_agent(lead)
        await agent.conduct_call(room)
```
